props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Internal expanded stack state accessor used by ToastContainer.

props.name: onToggleExpanded
props.description: Internal stack expansion handler used by ToastContainer.

props.name: canExpand
props.description: Whether a ToastContainer is present to drive stack expansion. When false (a bare ToastRegion, which has no expand/collapse context), the collapsed-stack "Show all" affordance is hidden because it cannot be honored — mirroring the upstream split where ToastContainer, not the low-level region, owns expansion.

props.name: placementEdge
props.description: Internal placement edge used for collapsed background stack positioning.

props.name: placementAlign
props.description: Internal placement alignment used for the toast's view-transition-class.
